take_homes: Giving people access to a tool is not the same as them using it. Like our portal.
Ask the person how they do the job today before building anything for them.
Somebody must own it and answer for it, or it dies.

monday.move: Ask one depot manager how he makes his weekly delivery report today
monday.when: Maybe Friday if I am at the depot
monday.stop_condition: If the answer is 'it comes out of the system and IT does it', I drop it
monday.blocker: No time, and the data is in a system I cannot export from without IT

misconception.why: Everything stayed about teammates and software work. Nothing showed AI doing something in operations or with a delivery report, so AI is still a chatbot thing to me. The portal example and the depot managers' Excel made me think, but they did not change what I think AI is.

one_line: Some good thinking about why people do not use new tools, but I did not see the agent do anything for my work, and too much English text.
